correctness.rationale: The conditional law given a degree-one marked vertex separates motif injections into avoiding, leaf-image, and higher-degree-image cases. Correct hypergeometric ratios simplify to the claimed exact normalized cross moment. Affineness in reciprocal edge count proves at most one strict crossing; positivity of the coefficient of motif leaf count proves its sign order. Independent exact graph enumerations (72) and grid checks (2,896) passed.

value.rationale: The exact formula characterizes covariance signs between standard local degree-one counts and arbitrary global motif counts across all allowed densities. It shows the topology effect collapses to motif leaf number, proves a single-crossing phase law, and exposes opposite path/star signs in the same fixed-edge graph. These are substantive natural dependence statements rather than routine numerical increments.
